title: Quake – 30th Anniversary Update
summary: Bethesda celebrates Quake's 30th anniversary with a major update featuring new content, visual enhancements, and community events to reinvigorate the classic 1996 first-person shooter for modern players.
problem_solved: Keeps a 30-year-old classic game relevant and engaging for both nostalgic players and new audiences.
why_valuable: Preserves gaming history while introducing classic FPS gameplay to new generations, strengthening the legacy of one of gaming's most influential titles.
